hints.title: Formulating Difference Array
hints.text: Define diff[k] = nums1[k] - nums2[k]. Equal range sums between i and j mean the sum of diff from i to j equals 0.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Equivalence
hints.text: A range sum of diff from i to j is 0 if and only if prefix_sum[j] == prefix_sum[i - 1].

hints.title: First Occurrence Hash Table
hints.text: Store the first seen index of each prefix sum in a hash map, initialized with {0: -1}. For each index j, the widest pair ending at j has width j - seen[prefix_sum[j]].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of binary arrays nums1 and nums2
complexity.notes: Single pass prefix difference with first occurrence tracking in a hash map.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all pairs (i, j) takes O(N^2) time which times out for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table reduces pairwise search to constant time lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should reduce equal range sums on two binary arrays to prefix sum difference matching.
